description: Fast first pass over many names: is there a registration record, since when, with which registrar, is it parked for sale. Uses public RDAP and DNS, so it works before any registrar is configured. It is NOT availability: no_record still has to be confirmed with search_domains or get_quote after nymwell_status reports a live registrar. No sign-in needed.

name.description: A name without an ending, e.g. noren

tlds.description: Endings to try with name; defaults to com, ai, dev, app, io, co, tw
